final_draft.answer: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer word for word. That answer is for control CC6.1, is owned by security@harborlight.example and is valid until 2027-11-16. It is backed by section 4.2 (Authentication) of the Access Control Policy, which says all workforce members must use a second factor. The answer says MFA is 'required', not that it is technically 'enforced'. I did not check any live GitHub or AWS settings because no organisation or account was given. Also, those checks cover GitHub and AWS, not the identity provider the answer refers to.
